spans.s: *पिडक m. आ f. a small boil or pimple.

पीड् पीड॑यति (पीड॑य˚ते) pp. पीडित (q.v.) press,
squeeze, oppress, suppress, vex, harass, pain, beleaguer (a city),
eclipse (sun or moon). — अभि press against, tread upon, press,
squeeze, vex, pain, beleaguer. अव press down, vex, harass. आ press
out, vex, plague. उद् press upwards or out of. उप press, suppress,
vex, pain. नि press against or together, plague, annoy. निस् press
out or together. परि press together, compress, plague or torment
greatly. प्र press, squeeze, pain. सम् press together, pain,
torment.
पीडा f. pain, ache, harm, wrong.
पीडाकर a. causing woe or harm.
पीडाकृत् a. causing woe or harm.
